actions.reason: K7_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity: coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, adipogenesis, and fatty-acid metabolism (RNA, q=0.001) plus near-universal PBRM1 mutation (14/14, q_global=7.85e-04) and VHL mutation (14/14). No candidate-specific technical factor is significant (confounder_association set report). Membership representation is conflicting (WXS strongly positive, CT/RNA/WSI reversed), but the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0001-K7_C0004 shows a represented current boundary (spectral agreement 0.758, within 0.431 > between 0.178) and K7_C0001-K7_C0007 shows strong representation (ARI 1.0, within 0.584 > between 0.172). These affirmative boundary results, together with the distinct PBRM1/VHL-mutant identity, support retention as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0002 has a coherent biological identity: immune-low/metabolic-high transcriptomic phenotype (down-regulated interferon/TNFa/IL6 programs, up-regulated OXPHOS and fatty-acid metabolism, q=0.001) with strong VHL-wild-type genomic signature (0/16 mutated, q_global=2.40e-03). No candidate-specific technical factor is significant. Although set-level membership representation is coherently reversed (all four silhouettes negative), the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0002-K7_C0003 (all four silhouettes positive, spectral ARI 1.0, within 0.396 > between 0.176) and K7_C0002-K7_C0005 (ARI 1.0, within 0.434 > between 0.113, union eigengap peaks at k=2). These affirmative boundary results support retention as an independent unit.

K7_C0003 has a coherent immune-high transcriptomic identity (up-regulated interferon gamma/alpha, TNFa/NF-kB, allograft rejection, q=0.001), directionally opposite to K7_C0002. WXS shows no multiplicity-robust driver-panel phenotype, and several candidate-specific technical factors are significant (tissue source site V=0.529, CT scanner model V=0.472, slice thickness/z-spacing epsilon-squared ~0.25), which weighs against terminal acceptance. However, the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0002-K7_C0003 (all four silhouettes positive, ARI 1.0) and K7_C0003-K7_C0005 (all four silhouettes positive, ARI 1.0, within 0.410 > between 0.100, union eigengap peaks at k=2). The internal-subdivision screen shows no dominant multi-cluster signal (screen_candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.801). These affirmative boundary results support retention, though the technical associations remain a caveat.

K7_C0004 has a coherent immune-low/TGF-beta-high transcriptomic identity (down-regulated interferon/IL6/complement and EMT, up-regulated TGF-beta, q=0.001). WXS shows no multiplicity-robust driver-panel phenotype, and several candidate-specific technical factors are significant (CT phase V=0.349, CT manufacturer V=0.222, slice thickness/z-spacing), which weighs against terminal acceptance. Set-level membership representation is weak-to-conflicting (WXS reversed, others null). However, the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0004-K7_C0006 (ARI 0.871, within 0.466 > between 0.085, union eigengap peaks at k=2) and K7_C0004-K7_C0007 (all four silhouettes positive, within 0.359 > between 0.135). These affirmative boundary results support retention, with the technical associations as a caveat.

K7_C0005 has a coherent immune-high transcriptomic identity (up-regulated allograft rejection, interferon gamma/alpha, IL6/JAK/STAT3, complement, q=0.001) plus a strong BAP1-mutant genomic signature (10/18, q_global=1.49e-03). Tissue source site (V=0.398) and CT z-spacing (epsilon-squared=0.058) show significant candidate-specific associations, a caveat. Set-level membership representation is weak-to-conflicting (only RNA positive). However, the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0005-K7_C0006 (ARI 1.0, within 0.533 > between 0.080, union eigengap peaks at k=2) and K7_C0003-K7_C0005 (all four silhouettes positive, ARI 1.0). These affirmative boundary results support retention.

K7_C0006 has a coherent mesenchymal/stromal-high transcriptomic identity (up-regulated EMT, mitotic spindle, Hedgehog, angiogenesis; down-regulated OXPHOS, q=0.001-0.007) plus a distinct VHL-mutant/PBRM1-wild-type genomic signature (VHL 13/13, PBRM1 0/13). No candidate-specific technical factor is significant. Set-level membership representation is conflicting (WXS perfect, CT/WSI/RNA reversed). However, the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0004-K7_C0006 (ARI 0.871, within 0.466 > between 0.085, union eigengap peaks at k=2) and K7_C0005-K7_C0006 (ARI 1.0, within 0.533 > between 0.080, union eigengap peaks at k=2). These affirmative boundary results support retention.

K7_C0007 has a coherent proliferation-high/immune-low transcriptomic identity (up-regulated E2F, G2M, MYC targets, glycolysis; down-regulated interferon programs, q=0.001-0.003). WXS shows no multiplicity-robust driver-panel phenotype, and no candidate-specific technical factor is significant. Set-level membership representation is conflicting (WXS perfect, WSI/RNA/CT reversed), and the set is very small (4 members), limiting stability. However, the pair boundaries to its nearest neighbors are positively supported: K7_C0001-K7_C0007 (ARI 1.0, within 0.584 > between 0.172) and K7_C0004-K7_C0007 (all four silhouettes positive, within 0.359 > between 0.135). These affirmative boundary results support retention, with small set size as a caveat.
